description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Fault, which manages XML-RPC fault responses, including fault codes and messages, XML serialization/deserialization, and fault detection.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Fault
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC fault, with properties for code, message, encoding, and methods for loading, saving, and detecting faults.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a fault with a code and message, using internal defaults if message is not provided.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the encoding for the fault and updates the related class.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Loads an XML string representing a fault, extracts fault code and message, and populates the object.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Static method to determine if a given XML string is an XML-RPC fault.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the fault object into an XML string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML string serialization of the fault.
